seo.title: About ODD — why we exist and what we are building
seo.description: ODD builds events, spaces and projects that strengthen creative work and connect creative fields with business and wider society.

title: Creativity belongs closer to the centre.
intro: ODD grew from a simple idea: Finland has extraordinary creative talent, and more can happen when the people, places and resources around it connect.
argument: Finland already has strong artists, organisations, institutions, funding and creative communities. The harder part is connecting them: projects, spaces, networks and partnerships often remain separate, making it harder for relationships, knowledge and opportunities to carry forward.

There is also more potential in bringing creative and cultural expertise into closer contact with business, institutions and public life. Creative practice carries real expertise in attention, taste, meaning and experimentation — and in turning ideas into things people can experience. These capabilities matter far beyond the cultural sector.

ODD builds places, events and projects where those connections can happen more naturally. We do not claim to represent every creative field; we make it easier for different people and practices to meet, work together and keep going.

story.title: How we got here.

milestones.title: New Nordic Way rf
milestones.body: The association is founded in Helsinki. The first ideas behind ODD begin to form.

milestones.title: Finding the gap
milestones.body: The question becomes clearer: Finland has strong creative talent, but the people, opportunities and resources around it do not always connect.

milestones.title: The first ODDfest
milestones.body: The first public experiment brings 2,600+ participants, 350+ contributors and 70+ partners together in Helsinki.

milestones.title: More than one event
milestones.body: Creative Week expands across Helsinki. ODDference develops into a conference where creative expertise meets business and society. ODDspace gives ODD a year-round home.

milestones.title: ODD becomes year-round
milestones.body: ODDfest becomes Helsinki’s creative week, taking place 19–25 April. ODDference continues as its own conference at Tanssin talo on 22–23 April, while ODDspace keeps ODD active year-round. Together, they create different ways to take part in ODD throughout the year.

story.legalNote: ODD is operated by New Nordic Way rf, a Finnish non-profit association based in Helsinki.

howWeMakeItHappen.title: Different needs call for different ways to take part.
howWeMakeItHappen.intro: One annual event cannot do everything. A workspace serves a different purpose from a city-wide week, and a good conversation does not become collaboration by itself. That is why ODD takes several different forms.

pillars.title: Events create reasons to gather
pillars.body: ODDfest makes creative activity across Helsinki visible as one shared week. ODDference brings people from different fields together around creative expertise. Both create moments that would not otherwise exist.

pillars.title: Spaces give people somewhere to return
pillars.body: ODDspace is the year-round home: a place to work, meet people, host events and stay connected between projects.

pillars.title: Projects and partnerships keep collaboration going
pillars.body: Projects and partnerships give us a way to keep working together beyond ODDfest, ODDference and ODDspace — when there is a clear reason to build something together.

howWeMakeItHappen.principlesTitle: A few things we try to hold onto.

principles.title: Make room for other people's work
principles.body: ODD should make room for people to bring their own ideas, practice and expertise — not make itself the centre of everything.

principles.title: Make it normal for different worlds to meet
principles.body: Creative fields, business and wider society do not need to become the same thing. They should be able to understand each other and work together without it feeling unusual.

principles.title: Participation over spectatorship
principles.body: ODD is strongest when people can do something: host, make, question, contribute, build or take responsibility.

principles.title: People are not the product
principles.body: Creatives are not a talent inventory for companies, and companies are not simply funding sources. Both have their own reasons to be there.

principles.title: Good intentions need good economics
principles.body: If something is meant to last, the economics need to work for the people actually making it — not just for the idea behind it.
